monotonicProjection.contract: Atomic per-session status/snapshot projection persists only monotonic durable sequence and capturedAt; stale retries skip without regression.

rollbackReceipt.contract: Durable quiet-period terminalization receipt binds lifecycle closure and zero active Outbox before rollback.

rollbackReceiptSingleUse.contract: Receipt is bound to the active v106 activation generation, unique, unconsumed and atomically consumed by rollback.

cutoverGeneration.contract: Every strategy activation receives a database-owned immutable generation UUID; terminalization and rollback must match the exact active v106 generation.

rawIngestBarrier.contract: Direct and fenced Raw persistence share the rollback advisory barrier; service_role can execute only the fenced wrapper.

isolatedRuntimeGate.contract: Service-role-only PostgreSQL provenance gate returns one bounded proof so no Python site package is needed during production cutover.

issuanceBarrier.contract: v105 issuance admission is serialized by a row-lock barrier; fence waits for admitted transactions and later callers fail closed.

successorIssuanceBarrier.contract: v106 issuance admission holds a shared row lock; rollback terminalization disables admission through an UPDATE that waits for every admitted transaction before receipt creation.

incidentEvidence.formal31Production: Exact cutover runner PASS and canonical /summary settlements persisted, but bursts of up to five Finals saturated the four-client priority DB lane. incidentEvidence.formal32Fix: Formal settlement receives one additional full outbox lease as bounded settle grace (max of lease and shadow shutdown). incidentEvidence.formal32Production: Exact cutover PASS, but the same Worker head retried after each 15s HTTP deadline. incidentEvidence.formal33Fix: Coalesce the exact session+sequence+payload identity onto one in-flight durable ingest promise. incidentEvidence.formal33Production: Single-flight stopped retry multiplication and exact cutover eventually passed, but first-attempt ACK still waited for synchronous local state/table fan-out. incidentEvidence.formal34Fix: After immutable raw DB commit and exact source-fence observation, return the durable ACK before scheduling local state/table prediction fan-out, ancillary projection and Outbox wake on setImmediate.
